research-report.heading: Executive summary
research-report.purpose: Answer the question with the central findings and decisive qualifications.

research-report.heading: Research question and scope
research-report.purpose: State the bounded question, reader, setting and inclusion boundaries.

research-report.heading: Search and selection methods
research-report.purpose: Describe this report’s actual search, screening, appraisal and synthesis methods.

research-report.heading: Findings and evidence synthesis
research-report.purpose: Synthesize supporting and contrary evidence by relevant themes.

research-report.heading: Discussion and implications
research-report.purpose: Interpret the synthesis, alternatives and supported implications.

research-report.heading: Limitations and unresolved questions
research-report.purpose: Identify evidence and report-method limits and what remains unresolved.

research-report.heading: Conclusion
research-report.purpose: Answer within the established bounds without introducing new evidence.

research-report.heading: References
research-report.purpose: Generated by the citation processor from cited sources.

literature-review.heading: Summary
literature-review.purpose: Summarize the question, coverage, principal synthesis and uncertainty.

literature-review.heading: Review question and scope
literature-review.purpose: State the review question and its conceptual, contextual and date boundaries.

literature-review.heading: Search and selection methods
literature-review.purpose: Describe the review’s actual discovery, selection, appraisal and synthesis.

literature-review.heading: Evidence overview
literature-review.purpose: Describe the included source types, contexts and inspection limitations.

literature-review.heading: Thematic synthesis
literature-review.purpose: Compare evidence across the themes needed to answer the review question.

literature-review.heading: Disagreements and evidence gaps
literature-review.purpose: Explain supported differences and gaps within the inspected evidence.

literature-review.heading: Interpretation and limitations
literature-review.purpose: Interpret the synthesis within study-level and review-level limits.

literature-review.heading: Conclusion
literature-review.purpose: State the supported answer and essential bounds without new evidence.

literature-review.heading: References
literature-review.purpose: Generated by the citation processor from cited sources.
